SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (1) Empty Nitrogen gas Cylinders shall be collected as per RSP's requirement from U nit-I, Oxygen Plant, RSP by the Party at their own cost. Loading and unloading of emp ty/full cylinders inside RSP premises is to be carried out by party at their own cost. (2) Fulfillment of Statutory requirement for filling of empty cylinders to be complied b y the supplier at their own cost like (a) Physical checking of cylinders. Test certificate to be supplied for each cylinder tested. (c) Replacement of missing/damaged valve protective caps. (d) Replacement of defective/damaged valves of cylinders. (3) Empty cylinders to be filled with required gases (Nitrogen) at 120 Kg/cm2 pressur e (Maximum 140 Kg/cm2) (4) Full cylinders to be delivered at Unit-I of Oxygen Plant at Party's own cost. (5) In case of missing/damage of cylinders during transportation or at Supplier's prem ises, Party has to replace the cylinders at their own cost. (6) Nitrogen Cylinders are of 46 Liters (Water volume) capacity and gas to be filled at 120 Kg/cm2 pressure (Maximum 140 Kg/Cm2). Quantity (volume) will be certified by the authorized representative of Oxygen Plant after measuring the average cylinder pressure of (approx.)10 cylinders from a lot and the average pressure so obtained sh all form the basis for calculation of volume as per the following formula: Volume of th e gas= (46 X Avg. Pressure obtained/1000) Nm3. (7) Sticker to be pasted on each cylinder mentioning nature of gas filled (Nitrogen),G as Filling Pressure and Date of gas filling. (8) Nitrogen Gas shall be filled in cylinder and OXYGEN CONTENT in Nitrogen Gas sha ll be Maximum 100 PPM. Test certificate to be submitted with each lot. (9)Empty Nitrogen gas Cylinders shall be collected from Unit-I, Oxygen Plant by the P arty through UCS code Nos. 72710001000056 respectively by Party's own arrangem ent. (10)Party has to quote in (Rupees/NM3) for Nitrogen gas including all cost for filling of

gas, transportation of empty & full cylinders and for fulfillment of statutory requireme nts as mentioned above. (11)In case of any major problems or breakdown of facility of cylinder filling (beyond control of the supplier), it is the responsibility of the supplier to arrange filling of Cylin ders from any other licensed Supplier of Nitrogen Cylinder Filling facility and maintai n the supply of Nitrogen Cylinders as per RSP's requirement at the same cost as that mentioned in the Purchase Order. Supplier shall be responsible for ensuring all safety & statutory requirements for this supply. (12) Before submitting the offer, the Bidder must visit Oxygen Plant and understand the scope of work fully. The Bidder has to submit an undertaking that he has fully un derstood the scope of work along with the offer. Packing Clause: Not Applicable Inspection at: At Unit-I,Oxygen Plant RSP after receipt of consignment.
